sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Debtor is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Looking for a bit of extra work, mate? There's this bloke who owes me a proper stack. Flash little tosser, always throwing his weight around, but when it's time to pay up, he's vanished. Been overdue for ages. Find him and have a proper word with him. You're good at that sort of thing. Last they saw the muppet, he was holed up in the downtown hotel on the second floor. Oh, one more thing. I need you to check out the flat that used to belong to the warden of the local "private" prison. You're heading that way anyway, so swing by while you're at it. And see if you can dig up the key to the cells as well."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the debtor on Streets of Tarkov
- Locate the private prison warden's apartment on Streets of Tarkov
- Hand over the item: Iron gate key

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Skier Rep +0.25
- 1,000 Euros
  - 1,050 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,150 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
"What, straight through him with a crowbar? No bloody way! Damn, my luck's been absolutely terrible lately."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |

| Iron gate key | 1 | Handover item | No | |

In this quest you first have to find the debtor on Streets of Tarkov. He can be found in room 206 on the second floor of the northern Pinewood hotel building. The room does not require a key.

Next you have to find the prison warden's apartment. The apartment is located in the Chekannaya 15 apartment building on Streets of Tarkov. A Chekannaya 15 apartment key is required to enter the apartment. The wanted apartment is the easternmost one on the second floor. It can only be accessed via the western staircase from the third floor through a hole in the floor of cell #5. The debris in the second floor hallway can only be passed by proning.
